title: Phase 6A minimal real calls (ordinary business task)
purpose: verify the provider adapters against real endpoints with the minimal ordinary-business task, within the configured and authorized test quota (relay test keys given by the user on 2026-10-12; the first two GPT samples in the ledger were made earlier with the previously configured relay key and are kept as history; the call cap was raised from 8 to 12 on 2026-10-12 at the user's request to retry Claude Opus 5.5 after the relay answered 503 'no available accounts' and then 404 'model not supported' for it)

tasks.purpose: explain why a formal model of a local order-processing service mispredicts the real service, by proposing one revision of a model constant (software model verification)
tasks.question: Which single revision of one boolean model constant indexed by station would make the model agree with the recorded run? Give the constant, the station and the new value.

providers.comparability_note: OpenAI-compatible protocol through the relay: the returned model name is the relay's report and cannot be verified as OpenAI's own
the native Messages protocol through the relay: stop_reason / refusal semantics are kept, but the returned model name is the relay's report
native Messages API at api.anthropic.com; needs FAL_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (a provider's own environment variable is never read)

missing_policy: every planned unit keeps a record; units without a model-produced response are MISSING in the model metrics (never 0 or 1) and counted by call outcome over the planned denominator; a refusal is never retried; only transport faults, lost responses, 429 and 5xx are retried (fixed allowance); on resume an unanswered unit is called again as a new sample

comparisons.note: both through the same relay: identities are relay-reported, so this is an engineering reading of two routes, not a verified provider comparison
